<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brandGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="132" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FE3675" opacity=".12"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="333" y1="16" x2="337" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="14" x2="344" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="347" y1="12" x2="351" y2="12" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="362" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="365" y1="18" x2="368" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="374" y="10" width="15" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="389" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Header controls -->
  <polyline points="31,66 22,75 31,84" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="47" y="80" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Back</text>
  <text x="195" y="79" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">tinder</text>
  <text x="365" y="79" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Done</text>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <text x="24" y="168" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">What’s your ethnicity?</text>
  <text x="24" y="194" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose the option that best describes you.</text>

  <!-- Search field -->
  <rect x="20" y="211" width="350" height="44" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="231" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="48" y1="236" x2="53" y2="241" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="65" y="236" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Search ethnicities</text>

  <!-- List card shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="20" y="270" width="350" height="322" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity=".07"/>
  <rect x="20" y="268" width="350" height="322" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- Row 1 -->
  <text x="42" y="302" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Asian</text>
  <text x="42" y="321" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">East, South or Southeast Asian</text>
  <circle cx="342" cy="307" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="338" x2="355" y2="338" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Row 2 selected -->
  <text x="42" y="373" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Black / African descent</text>
  <text x="42" y="392" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Black, African, Caribbean or Afro-Latinx</text>
  <circle cx="342" cy="378" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="342" cy="378" r="6" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="409" x2="355" y2="409" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Row 3 -->
  <text x="42" y="444" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Hispanic / Latino</text>
  <text x="42" y="463" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Hispanic, Latino or Spanish origin</text>
  <circle cx="342" cy="449" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="480" x2="355" y2="480" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Row 4 -->
  <text x="42" y="515" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Middle Eastern</text>
  <text x="42" y="534" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Middle Eastern or North African</text>
  <circle cx="342" cy="520" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="551" x2="355" y2="551" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Row 5 -->
  <text x="42" y="577" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">White</text>
  <circle cx="342" cy="573" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- More option -->
  <rect x="20" y="608" width="350" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="635" r="12" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="635" x2="52" y2="635" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="629" x2="46" y2="641" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="70" y="640" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Another ethnicity</text>
  <polyline points="348,631 353,636 348,641" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Privacy note -->
  <circle cx="29" cy="693" r="8" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="29" y="697" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#939393">i</text>
  <text x="45" y="697" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">This information helps us create a more inclusive</text>
  <text x="45" y="714" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">community and improve your matches.</text>

  <!-- Continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="82" y="732" width="226" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="759" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">SAVE & CONTINUE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="790" width="390" height="54" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="790" x2="390" y2="790" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Discover -->
  <polygon points="38,809 48,802 58,809 55,822 41,822" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="812" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
  <text x="48" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Discover</text>

  <!-- Likes -->
  <circle cx="125" cy="811" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <polygon points="125,817 119,811 121,807 125,810 129,807 131,811" fill="#939393"/>
  <text x="125" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Likes</text>

  <!-- Matches -->
  <rect x="185" y="804" width="20" height="15" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <polygon points="190,819 194,819 190,824" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="191" cy="811" r="1.5" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <circle cx="199" cy="811" r="1.5" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <text x="195" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Matches</text>

  <!-- Profile -->
  <circle cx="273" cy="809" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="273" cy="820" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <text x="273" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Profile</text>

  <!-- Settings -->
  <circle cx="345" cy="812" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <circle cx="345" cy="812" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="800" x2="345" y2="804" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="820" x2="345" y2="824" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <text x="345" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Settings</text>
</svg>
